native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 1, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. Both LEDs are off for the first 5 seconds after power-on or reset.'}
test2: {'time': 6, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off'}, 'description': 'First activation phase. After 5 seconds, LED1 turns on while LED2 remains off.'}
test3: {'time': 11, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'on'}, 'description': 'Second activation phase. After another 5 seconds (total 10 seconds), LED2 also turns on, so both LEDs are on.'}
test4: {'time': 16, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off'}, 'description': 'Deactivation phase. After another 5 seconds (total 15 seconds), both LEDs turn off simultaneously.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
